body:
## What to build

CloseIdleConnections retains active responses and releases genuinely idle connections after canceled dial waiters.

## Audit evidence

**H07: Connection usage counts have the wrong lifetime.** getClient increments useCount before waiting for shared dialing, but cancellation can return before installing its decrement. Conversely, successful RoundTrip decrements as soon as response headers arrive, while a response body can still be active. CloseIdleConnections can either retain an idle connection indefinitely after a canceled waiter or close a connection whose body is still being read.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define one balanced request lease from acquisition through stream/request-response completion.
- [ ] Cover cancellation while waiting for a shared dial without leaking useCount.
- [ ] Cover CloseIdleConnections during body reads and after body completion or Close.
- [ ] Preserve multiplexing and exactly-once release across all error paths.

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

## Delivery scope

One coherent PR, sized medium. 01 — Safety, cancellation and trustworthy CI. Numbered batches express recommended execution order; only the explicit blockers gate availability. This ticket groups related work as authorized by the audit owner. Findings describe source-confirmed mechanisms, not reproduced production incidents.

Preserve the accepted public API/module identity and packet-emission ownership contracts. Recheck the target branch before implementation. Closed experiment evidence and the finite scopes of existing issues #18, #44 and #46 remain intact.
